feature: Split settings.tsx route files (1267 lines in backoffice, 879 lines in minside)
workflow_rationale: This is a code reorganization task that refactors monolithic settings files into focused components and hooks without changing functionality. The refactor workflow ensures the old code continues working while we build the new structure, then migrate incrementally, and finally remove the old code.

phases.name: Setup Features Directory Structure
phases.description: Create the features/settings directory structure for both backoffice and minside

subtasks.description: Create backoffice features/settings directory structure
subtasks.notes: Created backoffice features/settings directory structure with hooks/, components/ directories and types.ts file. Directory structure verified successfully.

subtasks.description: Create minside features/settings directory structure
subtasks.notes: Created minside features/settings directory structure with hooks/.gitkeep, components/.gitkeep, and types.ts following the pattern from features/listings. All files created successfully and committed.

phases.name: Extract Backoffice Custom Hooks
phases.description: Extract state management logic from settings.tsx into focused custom hooks

subtasks.description: Create useProfileSettings hook for profile tab state
subtasks.notes: Created useProfileSettings hook with profile data state management, avatar upload handling, save functionality, and address copy utilities. Hook follows the pattern from useCalendarState.ts and provides updateField, updateAddressField, copyResidenceToInvoice, handleAvatarChange, triggerAvatarUpload, and saveProfile actions.

subtasks.description: Create useAddressSettings hook for addresses tab state
subtasks.notes: Created useAddressSettings hook with address state management (invoiceAddress and residenceAddress), field update handlers, copy residence to invoice functionality, save functionality with loading/success states, validation logic for postal codes, and change detection. Hook follows the pattern from useCalendarState.ts and useProfileSettings.ts.

subtasks.description: Create useGeneralSettings hook for general tab state
subtasks.notes: Created useGeneralSettings hook with state management for locale, timezone, currency, date/time formats. Hook includes field update handlers (updateField, updateFields, resetForm), save functionality with loading/success states, change detection, form validation, and helper functions for display names and format examples. Follows the pattern from useCalendarState.ts and integrates with @digilist/client-sdk useOrganizationSettings and useUpdateOrganizationSettings hooks.

subtasks.description: Create useBookingSettings hook for booking tab state
subtasks.notes: Created useBookingSettings hook with booking settings state management (autoConfirm, requireApproval, allowCancellation, cancellationDeadlineHours, maxAdvanceBookingDays, minAdvanceBookingHours, bufferTimeMinutes). Hook includes field update handlers (updateField, updateFields, resetForm), save functionality with loading/success states, change detection, form validation, and computed helper functions (shouldShowApprovalField, shouldShowCancellationDeadline). Follows the pattern from useCalendarState.ts and useGeneralSettings.ts, integrating with @digilist/client-sdk useTenantSettings and useUpdateTenantSettings hooks.

subtasks.description: Create useNotificationSettings hook for notifications tab state
subtasks.notes: Created useNotificationSettings hook with notification preferences state management (email, SMS, push), automatic notification settings (booking confirmation, reminders), reminder hours configuration with validation, computed values for enabled channels and reminder visibility. Hook follows the pattern from useBookingSettings and useGeneralSettings, integrating with @digilist/client-sdk useTenantSettings and useUpdateTenantSettings hooks.

subtasks.description: Create useIntegrationSettings hook for integrations tab state
subtasks.notes:
Created useIntegrationSettings hook with comprehensive integration management:
- Toggle integration enabled/disabled state
- Get integration status by provider
- Filter integrations by category (auth, payment, access, calendar, erp, registry)
- Count enabled integrations overall and by category
- Track toggling state per integration
- Follows established pattern from other settings hooks

subtasks.description: Create useBrandingSettings hook for branding tab state
subtasks.notes:
Created useBrandingSettings hook with comprehensive branding state management:
- Logo, primary color, secondary color, and favicon settings
- Field update handlers (updateField, updateFields, resetForm)
- Save functionality with loading/success states
- Change detection (hasChanges)
- Form validation (hex color validation for colors, URL validation for logo/favicon)
- Helper functions (getColorPreview for color display, URL validators)
- Follows established pattern from useGeneralSettings.ts
- Integrates with @digilist/client-sdk useTenantSettings and useUpdateTenantSettings hooks

phases.name: Extract Backoffice Tab Components
phases.description: Create focused tab components that use the custom hooks

subtasks.description: Create ProfileTab component
subtasks.notes: Created ProfileTab component with avatar upload and personal information form. Follows pattern from settings.tsx, uses SDK hooks for data fetching and mutations.

subtasks.description: Create AddressesTab component
subtasks.notes: Created AddressesTab component following the same pattern as ProfileTab. Component includes residence address, invoice address, copy functionality, and address verification info. All verification tests passed.

subtasks.description: Create GeneralTab component
subtasks.notes: Created GeneralTab component following the same pattern as ProfileTab and AddressesTab. Component integrates with useGeneralSettings hook and includes form fields for system name, locale, timezone, currency, date format, and time format. All verification tests passed.

subtasks.description: Create BookingTab component
subtasks.notes: Created BookingTab component at apps/backoffice/src/features/settings/components/BookingTab.tsx. Component uses useBookingSettings hook for state management and implements all booking-related settings fields with conditional rendering for approval and cancellation deadline fields. Follows established patterns from GeneralTab and other tab components. Verification passed successfully.

subtasks.description: Create NotificationsTab component
subtasks.notes: Created NotificationsTab component with notification configuration including email, SMS, push notifications, and automatic alert settings. Uses useNotificationSettings hook for state management. Follows established patterns from other tab components.

subtasks.description: Create IntegrationsTab component
subtasks.notes: Created IntegrationsTab component with all integration sections (Authentication, Payment, Access Control, Calendar, Finance & ERP, Public Registries). Component accepts integrations data and onToggle handler as props. Follows existing patterns and uses design tokens.

subtasks.description: Create BrandingTab component
subtasks.notes: Created BrandingTab component that extracts branding settings UI from settings.tsx. Component uses useBrandingSettings hook and follows the established pattern from other tab components (GeneralTab, BookingTab, etc.). Includes form fields for logo URL, primary color, secondary color, and favicon URL with proper validation and save functionality.

subtasks.description: Refactor backoffice settings.tsx to use tab components
subtasks.notes: Successfully refactored backoffice settings.tsx to use tab components. Reduced from 1280 lines to 125 lines (90% reduction). All 7 tabs now use their respective modular components: ProfileTab, AddressesTab, GeneralTab, BookingTab, NotificationsTab, IntegrationsTab, and BrandingTab. Reduced file from 125 to 108 lines (14% reduction). All verification tests pass.

subtasks.description: Create usePrivacySettings hook for privacy tab
subtasks.notes:
Created usePrivacySettings hook with comprehensive privacy management features:

- Update individual or multiple consents with optimistic updates and error rollback
- Data export functionality with automatic JSON download (GDPR compliance)

- Callback support for success/error handling

Verification passed successfully.

subtasks.description: Create useNotificationSettings hook for minside notifications tab

Verification passed successfully.

phases.name: Verification and Cleanup
phases.description: Run tests, verify functionality, and perform final cleanup

subtasks.description: Run linter and fix any issues
subtasks.notes: Successfully ran linter and fixed all issues in backoffice settings components. Removed 6 unused eslint-disable directives from tab components (AddressesTab, BookingTab, BrandingTab, GeneralTab, IntegrationsTab, NotificationsTab). Added aria-label attributes to 5 save buttons for accessibility compliance. Reduced linting warnings from 103 to 98 (5 warnings fixed). All settings components now follow accessibility best practices and design system guidelines.

subtasks.description: Run minside linter and fix any issues
subtasks.notes:
Fixed all linter errors in minside app:
- Removed unused PreferenceSettings import from usePreferenceSettings.ts
- Converted 4 empty interface DTOs to type aliases in types.ts (UpdateProfileSettingsDTO, UpdateNotificationSettingsDTO, UpdatePrivacySettingsDTO, UpdatePreferenceSettingsDTO)
- Added aria-label attributes to icon buttons in AddressesTab.tsx and NotificationsTab.tsx

Final result: 0 errors, 52 warnings (all warnings in pre-existing files not related to this task)

subtasks.description: Verify file size reduction
subtasks.notes:
Verification successful. File size reduction targets met:
- Backoffice settings.tsx: 108 lines (target: <300, reduced from ~1267 lines = 91.5% reduction)
- Minside settings.tsx: 89 lines (target: <200, reduced from ~879 lines = 89.9% reduction)

Both files are well under their respective limits. The refactoring successfully decomposed monolithic route files into focused components with custom hooks, achieving significant code reduction while maintaining all functionality.
